Top key bar · preset mode keys · vertical-slot grille · full-width flap stand
TENTATIVE · NOT A FINAL DESIGN
original concept · dimensions are guesses · 2026-11-25
10 mm
FRONT
REAR · stand closed
SIDE · mic end
SIDE · stand open, on desk

g.text: stand: full-width flap 38 mm long, hinged 8 mm below the top
opens ~76° from the body, body leans 40° back from vertical
balance: centre of mass 6 mm behind the pivot (needs lean > ~27°: tan th > D/H)

svg.text: CONTROLS (numbers match the callouts)
1 mic port: slots on the front (option: end-fire at left end)
2 key bar on top: press down to talk (telegraph key)
3 three preset keys DICT / TALK / OPEN, lamp inside each
4 lit key = current mode (no hidden state)
5 optional buzzer holes, far end from the mic
6 USB-C on the right end: cable runs to the laptop
7 full-width stand flap 8 rubber feet
+ WHY IT MIGHT WORK
Most distinctive and toy-like; big satisfying key bar
Preset keys + lamps: current mode is obvious at a glance
Wide body: room for electronics, buzzer, future batteries
Strong desk presence; reads clearly as a 'key'
- TRADEOFFS / RISKS
Handheld use is awkward: held like a bar, mic at one end
Needs >= ~30° recline to stand (tall-thin it is not)
Big bar travel may add lever/handling noise: isolate it
Mode keys are momentary: firmware must remember the state
Front slots look like TE's grille idea: keep them vertical
